**Process of Self-Exploration:**
Self-exploration is a dialogue between 'what I am' (our actual state) and 'what is naturally acceptable to me' (our design). It is a process of self-evolution through self-investigation.

**Content:** The content includes understanding human aspirations, desires, programs, and living in harmony at all four levels (individual, family, society, nature/existence).

**Natural Outcome:** Realization and understanding leading to right living, undivided society, and universal human order.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Proposal] -->|Keep in your own right| B(Natural Acceptance)
    B --> C[Experiential Validation]
    C --> D[Behavior & Work]
    D --> E[Realization & Understanding]
```

**Example:** When deciding career paths, external pressure might suggest a high-paying job I dislike, but my self-exploration reveals a natural acceptance for creative engineering that serves society, guiding my true choice.
proTip: Always mention that self-exploration has two parts: Proposal and Natural Acceptance, followed by experiential validation.
